summary.text: Winding Light Platform is Wan clan's Immortal Gu House. Fang Di Chang names it when Wan clan's first supreme elder arrives at tall pine oasis.

claims.text: It is a rank seven light path Immortal Gu House, greyish white with eight sides and eight corners. Wan clan’s first supreme elder stands on the tall platform and personally moved with the house after Wan Xiao’s request for reinforcements. From a few kilometers away it shot four beams of light that bent in the air and attacked Chicken Dog Coop from different directions. It then arrived and collided with Chicken Dog Coop, and a large number of mortal Gu broke into pieces and scattered in the air. It activated a killer move, and tens of beams of light swept the battlefield, forcing Chicken Dog Coop back with serious casualties among its ancient desolate beasts, and also striking Fang clan’s earth path Immortal Gu House underground until that house was almost destroyed.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Winding Light Platform is a named Immortal Gu House. It is mobile equipment of Wan clan, not a five-region map seat.

Wan clan’s first supreme elder activated Winding Light Platform’s signature method. Underground beams that had been straight and pure white bent and changed direction, and a large number of beams formed a web that shrouded Fang clan’s earth path Immortal Gu House until that house charged out of the ground after ten or so breaths. Fang Di Chang then controlled Chicken Dog Coop to collide with Winding Light Platform. Beams of light coiled around Winding Light Platform and connected with each other as a defensive ring, and the winding beams redirected the collision so Chicken Dog Coop brushed past. Winding Light Platform shot a ray of yellow light that covered Fang clan’s earth path Immortal Gu House and held it down on the spot. The yellow light coiled, and this strongest method would completely destroy that house in ten breaths, even the Gu Immortals inside could not escape alive. Winding Light Platform, at rank seven, possessed rank eight battle strength and blocked Fang Gong’s attacks. Fang Gong’s attacks possessed a strange power that could not destroy the house’s defensive methods, but infiltrated the inside and caused severe damage to the house’s Gu worms. The yellow beams of light lost their source of power and dispersed, and Wan clan’s first supreme elder controlled the house to retreat. Compared to tall pine oasis, Winding Light Platform was Fang clan’s true objective. Fang Gong held the house down while Chicken Dog Coop also attacked, and after enduring for a while Winding Light Platform crumbled apart. Fang Gong told Wan clan’s first supreme elder that Winding Light Platform is the price for going against Fang clan.

Ever since Fang clan attacked Wan clan’s tall pine oasis, Fang Gong is counted as having already destroyed Winding Light Platform, Red River Wheel, and Xiao clan’s Chamber Pot. Those three Immortal Gu Houses were all rank seven and could match rank eight battle strength.
